description_en: Queries the SLA compensation list for a user
description_zh: 查询用户SLA赔付列表情况
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-monthly-sla-list --months 202603 --product-codes oss --instance-ids rm-xxxxxxxxxxxx --pay-statuses 1 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --ec-id-account-ids '[{"AccountIds":[1501603440974415],"EcId":"1501603440974415"}]' --nbid 2684201000001 --api-version 2023-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMonthlySlaList

parameters.help_en: Optional. List of months in yyyyMM format
parameters.help_zh: 可选，月份列表，格式 yyyyMM
parameters.name: months

parameters.help_zh: 可选，产品 Code 过滤
parameters.name: product_codes

parameters.help_zh: 可选，实例 ID 过滤
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filter by compensation status. Valid values: 0 and 1
parameters.help_zh: 可选，赔付状态过滤，可选值 0/1
parameters.name: pay_statuses

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The list of accounts to access. If this parameter is empty, all accounts under the current entity ID are selected
fields.help_zh: 访问的账号列表，为空代表全选当前实体ID下所有账号
fields.name: account_ids

parameters.help_en: The enterprise and account list. If this parameter is empty, the current account is queried
parameters.help_zh: 企业与账号列表，为空表示查询当前账号自身
parameters.name: ec_id_account_ids

parameters.help_en: The primary marketplace ID. If this parameter is empty, the marketplace ID of the current user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 一级售卖场ID，如果为空，默认使用当前用户所属的场ID填充
parameters.name: nbid
